EvoGraph.isothermal_fixation.statement: theorem isothermal_fixation {W : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ} {r : ℝ} (hn : 0 < n) (hr : 0 < r) (hW : Isothermal W) (hsc : StronglyConnected W) (S : Finset (Fin n)) : Tendsto (fun t => sPow (bdK (fun _ => 1) W r) t S univ) atTop (𝓝 (moranFix n r S.card))

EvoGraph.isothermal_fixation_single.statement: theorem isothermal_fixation_single {W : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ} {r : ℝ} (hn : 0 < n) (hr : 0 < r) (hr1 : r ≠ 1) (hW : Isothermal W) (hsc : StronglyConnected W) (v : Fin n) : Tendsto (fun t => sPow (bdK (fun _ => 1) W r) t {v} univ) atTop (𝓝 ((1 - r⁻¹) / (1 - r⁻¹ ^ n)))

EvoGraph.isothermal_fixation_neutral.statement: theorem isothermal_fixation_neutral {W : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ} (hn : 0 < n) (hW : Isothermal W) (hsc : StronglyConnected W) (S : Finset (Fin n)) : Tendsto (fun t => sPow (bdK (fun _ => 1) W 1) t S univ) atTop (𝓝 ((S.card : ℝ) / n))

EvoGraph.isothermal_fixation_uniform.statement: theorem isothermal_fixation_uniform {W : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ} {r : ℝ} (hn : 0 < n) (hr : 0 < r) (hr1 : r ≠ 1) (hW : Isothermal W) (hsc : StronglyConnected W) : Tendsto (fun t => (∑ v : Fin n, sPow (bdK (fun _ => 1) W r) t {v} univ) / n) atTop (𝓝 ((1 - r⁻¹) / (1 - r⁻¹ ^ n)))

EvoGraph.stationary_fixation.statement: theorem stationary_fixation {μ : Fin n → ℝ} {W : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ} {r : ℝ} (hn : 0 < n) (hr : 0 < r) (hμ : ∀ i, 0 < μ i) (hW : RowStochastic W) (hstat : ∀ j, ∑ i, μ i * W i j = μ j) (hcut : CutPositive μ W) (S : Finset (Fin n)) : Tendsto (fun t => sPow (bdK μ W r) t S univ) atTop (𝓝 (moranFix n r S.card)) ∧ Tendsto (fun t => sPow (bdK μ W r) t S ∅) atTop (𝓝 (1 - moranFix n r S.card))

EvoGraph.forward_bias.statement: theorem forward_bias {μ : Fin n → ℝ} {W : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ} (r : ℝ) (hrow : ∀ i, ∑ j, W i j = 1) (hstat : ∀ j, ∑ i, μ i * W i j = μ j) (S : Finset (Fin n)) : upP μ W r S = r * downP μ W r S

EvoGraph.bd_fixation_mono.statement: theorem bd_fixation_mono {μ : Fin n → ℝ} {W : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ} {r : ℝ} (hn : 0 < n) (hr : 0 < r) (hμ : ∀ i, 0 < μ i) (hW : RowStochastic W) (t : ℕ) (S : Finset (Fin n)) : sPow (bdK μ W r) t S univ ≤ sPow (bdK μ W r) (t + 1) S univ

EvoGraph.cutPositive_of_strongly_connect.statement: theorem cutPositive_of_strongly_connected {μ : Fin n → ℝ} {W : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ} (hμ : ∀ i, 0 < μ i) (hsc : StronglyConnected W) : CutPositive μ W

EvoGraph.two_absorbing_limit.statement: theorem two_absorbing_limit {P : σ → σ → ℝ} {bot top : σ} (hP : TwoAbsorbing P bot top) {h : σ → ℝ} (hh : ∀ s, s ≠ bot → s ≠ top → ∑ u, P s u * h u = h s) (h0 : h bot = 0) (h1 : h top = 1) (hvar : ∀ s, s ≠ bot → s ≠ top → 0 < ∑ u, P s u * (h u - h s) ^ 2) (s : σ) : Tendsto (fun t => sPow P t s top) atTop (𝓝 (h s)) ∧ Tendsto (fun t => sPow P t s bot) atTop (𝓝 (1 - h s))

EvoGraph.cycle4_not_lumpable.statement: theorem cycle4_not_lumpable : ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 4)).card = ({0, 2} : Finset (Fin 4)).card ∧ upP (fun _ => 1) Wcyc 2 {0, 1} = 1 / 3 ∧ upP (fun _ => 1) Wcyc 2 {0, 2} = 2 / 3 ∧ upP (fun _ => 1) Wcyc 2 {0, 1} = 2 * downP (fun _ => 1) Wcyc 2 {0, 1} ∧ upP (fun _ => 1) Wcyc 2 {0, 2} = 2 * downP (fun _ => 1) Wcyc 2 {0, 2}

EvoGraph.star_ne_moran.statement: theorem star_ne_moran : (5 / 12 : ℝ) ≠ moranFix 3 2 1 ∧ (7 / 12 : ℝ) ≠ moranFix 3 2 1 ∧ (2 / 3 : ℝ) ≠ moranFix 3 2 1

EvoGraph.identity_no_fixation.statement: theorem identity_no_fixation : Isothermal (Wid 2) ∧ (∀ t, sPow (bdK (fun _ => 1) (Wid 2) 2) t {0} univ = 0) ∧ ¬ Tendsto (fun t => sPow (bdK (fun _ => 1) (Wid 2) 2) t {0} univ) atTop (𝓝 (moranFix 2 2 ({0} : Finset (Fin 2)).card))

EvoGraph.star_fixation_centre.statement: theorem star_fixation_centre : Tendsto (fun t => sPow (bdK (fun _ => 1) Wstar 2) t {0} univ) atTop (𝓝 (5 / 12))

EvoGraph.star_fixation_leaf.statement: theorem star_fixation_leaf : Tendsto (fun t => sPow (bdK (fun _ => 1) Wstar 2) t {1} univ) atTop (𝓝 (2 / 3))

EvoGraph.star_fixation_uniform.statement: theorem star_fixation_uniform : Tendsto (fun t => (∑ v : Fin 3, sPow (bdK (fun _ => 1) Wstar 2) t {v} univ) / 3) atTop (𝓝 (7 / 12))

EvoGraph.starStationary_fixation.statement: theorem starStationary_fixation : Tendsto (fun t => sPow (bdK muStar Wstar 2) t {0} univ) atTop (𝓝 (4 / 7))

EvoGraph.wellMixed3_fixation.statement: theorem wellMixed3_fixation : Tendsto (fun t => sPow (bdK (fun _ => 1) (WH 3) 2) t {0} univ) atTop (𝓝 (4 / 7))

EvoGraph.fit.text: noncomputable def fit (r : ℝ) (S : Finset (Fin n)) (i : Fin n) : ℝ := if i ∈ S then r else 1

EvoGraph.ind.text: noncomputable def ind (S : Finset (Fin n)) (i : Fin n) : ℝ := if i ∈ S then 1 else 0

EvoGraph.upd.text: def upd (S : Finset (Fin n)) (i j : Fin n) : Finset (Fin n) := if i ∈ S then insert j S else S.erase j

EvoGraph.totFit.text: noncomputable def totFit (μ : Fin n → ℝ) (r : ℝ) (S : Finset (Fin n)) : ℝ := ∑ k, μ k * fit r S k

EvoGraph.coef.text: noncomputable def coef (μ : Fin n → ℝ) (W : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ) (r : ℝ) (S : Finset (Fin n)) (i j : Fin n) : ℝ := μ i * fit r S i / totFit μ r S * W i j

EvoGraph.bdK.text: noncomputable def bdK (μ : Fin n → ℝ) (W : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ) (r : ℝ) (S T : Finset (Fin n)) : ℝ := ∑ i, ∑ j, coef μ W r S i j * (if upd S i j = T then 1 else 0)

EvoGraph.upP.text: noncomputable def upP (μ : Fin n → ℝ) (W : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ) (r : ℝ) (S : Finset (Fin n)) : ℝ := ∑ T, bdK μ W r S T * (if T.card = S.card + 1 then 1 else 0)

EvoGraph.downP.text: noncomputable def downP (μ : Fin n → ℝ) (W : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ) (r : ℝ) (S : Finset (Fin n)) : ℝ := ∑ T, bdK μ W r S T * (if T.card + 1 = S.card then 1 else 0)

EvoGraph.RowStochastic.text: structure RowStochastic (W : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ) : Prop where nonneg : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ W i j rowSum : ∀ i, ∑ j, W i j = 1

EvoGraph.CutPositive.text: def CutPositive (μ : Fin n → ℝ) (W : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ) : Prop := ∀ S : Finset (Fin n), S ≠ ∅ → S ≠ univ → ∃ i ∈ S, ∃ j ∉ S, 0 < μ i * W i j

EvoGraph.StronglyConnected.text: def StronglyConnected (W : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ) : Prop := ∀ a b, Relation.TransGen (fun x y => 0 < W x y) a b

EvoGraph.Isothermal.text: structure Isothermal (W : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ) : Prop extends RowStochastic W where colSum : ∀ j, ∑ i, W i j = 1

EvoGraph.sPow.text: noncomputable def sPow (P : σ → σ → ℝ) : ℕ → σ → σ → ℝ | 0 => fun s u => if s = u then 1 else 0 | t + 1 => fun s u => ∑ v, sPow P t s v * P v u

EvoGraph.TwoAbsorbing.text: structure TwoAbsorbing (P : σ → σ → ℝ) (bot top : σ) : Prop where ne : bot ≠ top nonneg : ∀ s u, 0 ≤ P s u rowSum : ∀ s, ∑ u, P s u = 1 absorbBot : ∀ u, P bot u = if u = bot then 1 else 0 absorbTop : ∀ u, P top u = if u = top then 1 else 0

EvoGraph.Wstar.text: noncomputable def Wstar : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ := ![![0, 1 / 2, 1 / 2], ![1, 0, 0], ![1, 0, 0]]

EvoGraph.Wid.text: noncomputable def Wid (n : ℕ) : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ := fun i j => if i = j then 1 else 0

EvoGraph.WH.text: noncomputable def WH (n : ℕ) : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ := fun _ _ => 1 / n
